title: Flatten Nested List Iterator
problemStatement: A nested list contains integers or other nested lists. Design an iterator that supports the following operations: next() — returns the next integer. hasNext() — returns whether there are more integers remaining. Process a sequence of iterator operations on the given nested list.
input: A nested list of integers. A sequence of iterator operations.
output: For each next() operation, print the returned integer. For each hasNext() operation, print true or false.
constraints: The total number of integers does not exceed 10^5.
